repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for AI agents to lookup function signatures from any API. Uses SQLite and universal ctags to index source    files across multiple languages (Python, C, Go, C++, JS, Rust, Java, etc.). Prevents hallucination on unknown or    recently updated source files by providing accurate function signatures
